value.name: Lucia avoids eye contact
value.description: Lucia keeps her eyes on the desk instead of looking at the two women beside her, signaling hesitation and guardedness.
evidence: Lucia kept her eyes on the desk rather than on either woman beside her, as though she had set down something she was not sure she would be allowed to pick back up.

value.name: Asha aligns the letters
value.description: Asha moves the folded letter so the handwriting on Lucia's letter lines up with the writing on the desk page, suggesting comparison or verification.
evidence: Asha's fingertips found the soft crease of the folded letter and slid it down over the divergent strokes until the firmer hand on Lucia's letter lay directly above the firmer hand on the desk page, the two inked lines stacked now in a single narrow band of lamplight.

value.name: Lucia allows the comparison
value.description: Lucia does not withdraw and instead lets her fingertips remain with Asha's before nudging the paper forward, a small sign of reluctant cooperation.
evidence: Lucia did not pull back; her own fingertips lingered at the crease alongside Asha's, then pushed the paper another fraction forward, a small ceding gesture

value.name: Daniel listens at the door
value.description: Outside the study, Daniel stops at the hall door and listens for the voices inside without entering.
evidence: Beyond that door, Daniel had stopped short of the handle; the floorboard outside the study took his weight and held it, and he stood listening for the shape of voices he could not quite make out.

value.name: Asha and Lucia remain silent
value.description: The room stays tense and quiet as the women hold their positions and the evidence on the desk waits to be interpreted.
evidence: Inside, none of them spoke; the radiator ticked, and the alignment of the two firmer hands sat under the lamp waiting to be read as either the same writer twice or a careful imitation of her.

value.name: Asha removes the folded letter
value.description: Asha slowly lifts the folded letter away, exposing the desk page again and prompting Lucia to meet her gaze.
evidence: Asha drew the folded letter slowly off the blotter, uncovering the firmer hand on the desk page alone again under the lamp, and lifted her eyes to Lucia's.

value.name: Asha asks if this is the last piece
value.description: Asha quietly asks Lucia whether the document they are examining is the final missing piece.
evidence: "Is this the last piece?" she whispered

value.name: Lucia glances toward the hall door
value.description: Lucia's attention briefly shifts to the closed hall door before returning to Asha, showing concern about being overheard.
evidence: Lucia's fingertips slid back from the crease as if released, and her gaze went once to the closed hall door before it returned to Asha
